start_time_note: One row per ride. Start lists (official, per heat: heat time + running order) give the order of the boats in each heat; each heat-run is one Race number, Run 1 rides then Run 2 (then Run 3). No per-ride clocks are printed anywhere: the heat's printed start time is on every ride of the heat, all runs (contract heat-time rule; start_times scheduled, start_times_kind heat). A ride row exists only where the Phase Results print a score for that run. Squirt semi-finals and finals have no start list: order is the Phase Results order (rank order), time from the PWW schedule (finals: heat time; semi-finals: block, see block_times). Declared scheduled starts: gap between rides not printed; the schedule allots 25 min per prelim/semi heat (4-6 boats x 2 runs), 35 min per quarterfinal, 45-55 min per final.
